newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Santos says well builds on Barrolka field.
newsitem.headline: Santos says well builds on Barrolka field.

text.p: Oil and gas producer Santos Ltd said on Tuesday a gas flow at its Coolah-1 well in Queensland has added to encouraging results at the Barrolka field complex.
The exploration well in ATP 259P flowed gas at 2.05 million cubic feet a day in an open hole flow test of the interval 2,555 metres to 2,586 metres through a half-inch choke, Santos said.
Coolah-1, the sixth well drilled to assess the size and deliverability of the Barrolka field complex, lies about 50 km north of the Queensland Gas Centre.
Santos last month said the complex appeared to have a resource of several hundred billion cubic feet of gas.
"Coolah-1, which addresses a separate sub-structure, builds on these encouraging results," Santos general manager, Queensland and Northern Territory, Rod McArdle said.
"The joint venture will now drill a further sub-structure, Barrolka northeast, in order to further assess the resource associated with the Barrolka field complex," he said in a statement.

Participants in Coolah-1 are operator Santos with 58.8625 percent, Exxon Corp unit Delhi Petroleum Pty Ltd with 23.2 percent, Boral Ltd's Boral Energy Resources Ltd with 16.25 percent, Gulf Australian Hydrocarbons Ltd with 1.2 percent and Oil Co of Australia Ltd with 0.2375 percent.
